mechanism: put the idle rows to work on a tie: when the best uniform row-group layout leaves groups idle, the planner takes a mixed-height layout with one expert per group, the same modelled makespan and a lower summed expert cost, so mistral / minimax-m3 run 3+3+2+2 rows (6-tile experts at per_core_M 2) instead of 2x5 with rows y10-11 idle
